item.title: [IGNITE-2190] ScanQuery without a filter triggers object's deserialization on the server side
item.description:
The issue is reproduced on version 1.4 where legacy PortableMarshaller is used. However, I'm quiet sure that the issue happens when BinaryMarshaller is used as well in 1.5.

1) Start a server using ignite.sh/bat

2) Create a simple app, that uses binary or portable marshaller, creates a cache dynamically and executes a ScanQuery like below
int size=employees1.query(new ScanQuery()).getAll().size();

3) As you see the query doesn't use any filters. However on the server side some filter is still being checked org.apache.ignite.internal.processors.cache.query.GridCacheQueryManager$5.checkPredicate(GridCacheQueryManager.java:963) which makes the server to deserialize a value.

According to the stack trace there is some internal filter that triggered checkPredicate function - filter=o.a.i.i.processors.cache.IgniteCacheProxy$1@3224ff7b.

The issue is still reproduced even after IGNITE-2178 has been fixed.

Attached a reproducible example that was executing again ignite-1.5 branch.

https://github.com/apache/ignite/pull/1948

IGNITE-2190:

  • Added GridCacheEmptyScanQueryTest to reproduce bug described in task
  • Test succeed for a OptimizedMarshaller but fails for a BinaryMarshaller
  • Minor fixes in IgniteProcessProxy and GridAbstractTest for a possibility to modify separate jvm grid classpath

Hello.

Here is test case.
It fails because of ClassNotFoundException.

testEmptyScan can be fixed in two independent ways:

1. exclude EVT_CACHE_QUERY_OBJECT_READ from IncludeEventTypes configuration parameter.
2. use cache.withKeepBinary() when run ScanQuery

testScanWithPredicate can be fixed only by using cache.withKeepBinary()

My question is - Should I try to fix default behavior of ScanQuery processing that leads to ClassNotFoundException?

package org.apache.ignite.internal.processors.cache;

import java.util.List;
import javax.cache.Cache;
import org.apache.ignite.Ignite;
import org.apache.ignite.IgniteCache;
import org.apache.ignite.cache.query.ScanQuery;
import org.apache.ignite.configuration.CacheConfiguration;
import org.apache.ignite.configuration.IgniteConfiguration;
import org.apache.ignite.events.EventType;
import org.apache.ignite.lang.IgniteBiPredicate;
import org.apache.ignite.spi.discovery.tcp.TcpDiscoverySpi;
import org.apache.ignite.spi.discovery.tcp.ipfinder.TcpDiscoveryIpFinder;
import org.apache.ignite.spi.discovery.tcp.ipfinder.vm.TcpDiscoveryVmIpFinder;
import org.apache.ignite.testframework.GridTestUtils;
import org.apache.ignite.testframework.junits.common.GridCommonAbstractTest;

public class IgniteCacheBinaryObjectsScanSelf2Test extends GridCommonAbstractTest {
    private static final TcpDiscoveryIpFinder IP_FINDER = new TcpDiscoveryVmIpFinder(true);
    private static final String PERSON_CLS_NAME = "org.apache.ignite.tests.p2p.cache.Person";
    private static final String PERSON_KEY_CLS_NAME = "org.apache.ignite.tests.p2p.cache.PersonKey";
    private static ClassLoader ldr;

    @Override protected void beforeTestsStarted() throws Exception {
        ldr = getExternalClassLoader();

        startGrids(3);

        startGrid("client");
    }

    @Override protected void afterTestsStopped() throws Exception {
        ldr = null;

        stopAllGrids();
    }

    @Override protected IgniteConfiguration getConfiguration(String igniteInstanceName) throws Exception {
        IgniteConfiguration cfg = super.getConfiguration(igniteInstanceName);
        TcpDiscoverySpi discoSpi = new TcpDiscoverySpi().setIpFinder(IP_FINDER);

        cfg.setDiscoverySpi(discoSpi);
        cfg.setIncludeEventTypes(EventType.EVTS_ALL);
        cfg.setMarshaller(null);
        cfg.setPeerClassLoadingEnabled(true);

        if ("client".equals(igniteInstanceName)) {
            cfg.setClientMode(true);
            cfg.setClassLoader(ldr);
        }

        return cfg;
    }

    public void testEmptyScan() throws Exception {
        IgniteCache<Object, Object> cache = cache();

        populateCache(cache);

        List<Cache.Entry<Object, Object>> entries = cache.query(new ScanQuery<>()).getAll();
        assertEquals(100, entries.size());
    }

    public void testScanWithPredicate() throws Exception {
        IgniteCache<Object, Object> cache = cache();

        populateCache(cache);

        List<Cache.Entry<Object, Object>> entries = cache.query(new ScanQuery<>(new IgniteBiPredicate<Object, Object>() {
            @Override public boolean apply(Object o, Object o2) {
                return true;
